observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as an undifferentiated body that ships together — not a hierarchy or exchange.
Velocity measured in points is proportionality — output quantified and compared against a benchmark ('highest this quarter'), a cost/benefit or ROI framing of team productivity.

Naming an integration as 'the key unlock' frames a shared collective resource that opened the team's path — communal-sharing's undifferentiated pooling of credit into a common enabler rather than individual contribution or ranked allocation.
